# pantechdynamics_certificate_import (Resource)

A certificate and private key you bring, for Pantech services such as load balancers to use. Pantech never renews it: change the PEMs (for the same names) and apply to replace it in place. **The private key is kept in Terraform state** (as a sensitive value): treat the state as a secret. A certificate a Pantech service uses cannot be deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Bring your own certificate for Pantech services to use. The private key is
# kept in Terraform state: treat the state as a secret. Pantech never renews
# an imported certificate: change the files (same names) and apply to
# replace it in place.
resource "pantechdynamics_certificate_import" "shop" {
  certificate_pem = file("${path.module}/shop.example.org.crt")
  chain_pem       = file("${path.module}/intermediates.pem")
  private_key_pem = file("${path.module}/shop.example.org.key")
  description     = "Bought from our CA"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certificate_pem` (String) The certificate, PEM. Changing it re-imports in place; the new certificate must have the same names.
- `private_key_pem` (String, Sensitive) The certificate's private key, PEM (PKCS #8, PKCS #1 or EC), not encrypted. Sensitive, and kept in state. Changing it re-imports in place.

### Optional

- `chain_pem` (String) The intermediate certificates, PEM, leaf excluded. Defaults to "". Changing it re-imports in place.
- `description` (String) A note for yourself, at most 255 characters. Defaults to "".
- `exportable` (Boolean) Whether the certificate and key can be exported again (pantechdynamics_certificate_export). Defaults to false. Changing it imports a new certificate.

### Read-Only

- `common_name` (String) The certificate's common name, or null.
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the certificate, lower-case hex. A re-import made outside Terraform shows as a change, which the next apply sets back.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the certificate, starting with cert_.
- `issuer` (String) The issuer's name as written in the certificate.
- `key_type` (String) The key's type: "ecdsa-p256", "ecdsa-p384", "rsa-2048", "rsa-3072" or "rsa-4096".
- `names` (List of String) The DNS names the certificate is for, read from it.
- `not_after` (String) End of validity, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `not_before` (String) Start of validity, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `serial_number` (String) The serial number, in hexadecimal.
- `status` (String) "issued", or "expired" once not_after has passed (Pantech does not renew an imported certificate).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An imported certificate is imported by its id. The PEMs cannot be read
# back: keep them in the configuration. The next apply recognises the same
# certificate by its fingerprint and sends nothing.
terraform import pantechdynamics_certificate_import.shop cert_06ggfcabcdefghjkmnpqrstvw
```
